scope: one checked out Mercata repository with 244 registered itch.io task records, one user-visible gallery record and its existing evidence
unit: task, relative evidence path, claim-to-source reference, or gallery link

checks.method: exact baseline and detailed task count, fixed IDs and progress/acceptance flags
read every task evidence link and require a tracked local file without path traversal
require every claim source reference to be a registered HTTPS source with retrieval date, author and reuse note
require one itch.io gallery card, source dossier and task plan/queue paths
recompute whole-ledger mean and each workstream score; complete status exactly matches 100

qualifications: This verifies internal reference integrity, not the content, availability or current accuracy of every outside URL.
A source with a reuse note is not automatically licensed for image or dataset republication.
An existing test suite passing is evidence of machine consistency, not of representative seller incomes.
New files added by this audit increase the total tracked files and task links; precommit snapshot is historical.
An actual market statistic remains unsupported unless the underlying sampling frame and transaction data exist.
